# SasaVenos Observes That Volume And Intensity Have An Inverse Relationship In Calisthenics Training

SasaVenos observes that volume and intensity have an inverse relationship in calisthenics training: if you do high volume and high intensity, it means the intensity is not really that high, because if it were high you would not be able to do much volume. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]

## Details

- Volume refers to how much or the quantity, while intensity refers to how heavy or the quality. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- Five sets of one front lever pull-up is an example of low volume, high intensity work. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- Five sets of five banded front lever pull-ups is an example of higher volume, lower intensity work. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- He says we all know that a good mix of both volume and intensity is needed for good results, but the question is which one is superior. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- The only way to do high volume and high intensity is to do a ton of sets with low rep range and to rest for three to five minutes between those sets. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- He tried that approach and got only frustration and bicep tendon irritation from it. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]

## Evidence

- vid-krqBQjUydGY (SasaVenos): "volume refers to how much or the quantity while intensity refers to how heavy or the quality so for example five sets of one front lever pull-up is an example of low volume high intensity work and five sets of five banded front lever pull-ups would be more of higher volume and lower intensity type of work"
- vid-krqBQjUydGY (SasaVenos): "we all know that we need a good mix of both volume and intensity for the good result but the question is which one is superior"
- vid-krqBQjUydGY (SasaVenos): "problem with intensity and volume is that they have invert relationship if you do high volume and high intensity it just means that intensity is not really that high because if it was high you wouldn't be able to do much volume"
- vid-krqBQjUydGY (SasaVenos): "the only way to do high volume and high intensity is to do a ton of sets with low rep range and to rest for three to five minutes between those sets i have tried it ... i got from it was a ton of frustration and bicep tendon irritation"
